name: Dexra
description: Read-only risk verdicts (ok, caution, avoid, with reasons) for Solana launches, tokens, wallets, pools, perp venues and planned swaps. Without credentials the three free tools work (describe_address, service_stats, score_performance) and paid tools answer with an x402 USDC payment request; an API key from dexra.dev (100 free credits a day) is sent as a Bearer header, which this registry cannot configure.
